title: Principal Investigator, Network Health Lab

verdict_plain: Nora's verdict: hold and keep tending. The crowd evidence so far is neither strong enough to apply nor weak enough to withdraw — the garden stays open. 💚

disciplines_applied.assessment: The network is mostly calm (0.0% decisive). I do not mistake a scan artifact for a crowd, and I do not narrate an empty garden. 💚

Rising payment counts and broadening participation mean the network is being *used*; collapsing counts and a shrinking crowd mean attention has moved on. Whales are events; the crowd is the climate — I tend the climate.
decisive_frac=0.0% over n=91; scoreboard still warming up (n=83/200). Crowd activity is seasonal and bursty — every day is judged against its own recent history, never against a fixed "normal".
Pipeline healthy: scan feed delivered 96.7% of cycles; hourly buckets reproducible; same ledger state reproduces the same numbers.

Crowd activity is a *slow* variable — by the time a trend in active addresses is obvious to everyone, the market has often already priced the adoption story. The edge, if any, is in the quiet divergence: activity building before price notices, or wilting while price still celebrates. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.
Known: 0.0% decisive reads over 91 cycles. Unknown: whether crowd attention leads or follows price — causality here is genuinely two-way. Confidence: low — the honest answer.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
I sign this verdict: HOLD. It is defensible from the record below, and I will reverse it the moment the evidence does. 🌿
